FOLIO NO. 06 — SPOTLIGHT
The Black Barn returns to the spring calendar.

After a quiet winter — new flooring, a re-painted kitchen, and a six-volume rotation in the library — the Black Barn at Kerteminde reopens its doors on the third of May. We have lifted a single weekend already for those wishing to be first.

FOLIO NO. 07 — SPOTLIGHT
Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we most often photograph at four in the afternoon — when the low sun pulls the lime-wash into a copper and the sea-fog gathers, almost evening, near the kitchen. A reading of the limestone, in two seasons.

Architect
Anders Coelho
